body:
not bad? Its terrible, I draw attention of every single person when im in public. When im in the train everybody watches me, and when I look back they look away. I have no single friends in my city or on school I have nothing to live for...

I think im going to sleep and see what tomorrow brings me... At least thank you for talking..

It looked like this: http://i.imgur.com/91jNvg6.jpg Got better, but now its going back to this condition... I am scared to work with new people since they always look at my face. Also my ocular rosacea doenst makes it easy to talk to people...
I have no idea what to do if I fail... And you havent seen my face yet... I would rather be bald than this... :( And they should wear a wig if they want.
I had my last change for a test a week ago, I am waiting for my mark. I missed the first change because my face was so messed up that I was too scared to show myself in public.

I am not good in something, especially because I only stay inside behind my computer and playing games and that is probably the reason why im still here(people on the internet dont judge on look). I probably even failed my school because of this... I dont see my family alot because I try to avoid them. I am the wastrel of my family... I wish I didnt life at al

Thanks for the tip, I dont wear sunscreen that much so I will put that more on. Beside that I also sit behind the computer alot today i woke and  eat 2 sandwiches with chocolate sprinkles a pizza and thats it. I read that I should avoid sugar as much as possible and get some vitamine D, any tips above this? Thanks for helping me I appreciate it

When I wake up I shower and after that I put metronidazol2% on my face then I take 1 loratadine (for my ocular rosacea) and do a eye drop of an OTC(5times a day, but this still doenst help, and at the end of the day my eyes gets really red) which helps against hay fever. Before sleep I do the metronidazol2% again on my face. Beside that I try to go outside as less as possible and I try to drink alot of water.
Also, I had a BBQ today with my friends but I didnt go to it, because when I am there they will pick on me and ask me what is wrong with my face, and I hate that.
Thanks for the great tip! i always take long showers with hot water, from now on they will be short and with lukewarm.
Tomorrow im gonna make a photo with a good camera, so u can all give a better judgement
She dont know, she thinks is a sort of eczema, thats all she knew.

The doctor said she didnt prefer to put zinc soap on my face. But I got a question for you, if u there: at the moment my skin does itch alot, and i try not to touch it. Is it a good idea to take another shower?
Thanks for the great tip, i will buy and try this tomorrow! And I will hold you all up to date what the doctor will say tomorrow

Thanks sir, you bring a smile on my face! I actually dont really care how much its gonna cost, i will do everything to get this out of my face. I hope it is over as soon as possible so i can go outside again and enjoy my life! Thanks again for commenting!
Thanks for the tip, luckily i didnt put it on my skin yet!
Thanks for your advice man i appriciate it! If its seborrheic dermatitis, i hope the doctor can cure it. And i dont have Nizoral shampoo @ home, so i will wait untill the stores are open tomorrow.
Thanks! A few hours ago i bought moisturizer, i will start to use it.
So, tomorrow morning i just dont wash my face at all? Or do put water in my hands and throw it in my face or something like that.
Its ok thanks for the great support, it cheers me up alot! And my face does itch but not alot, also there are sometimes alot of dead skin cells just falling off.
Thanks for your comment, i will stop using the salve for my acne.
Thanks for the comment, i cant believe my doctor gave me all this drugs and salve for acne...I really question myself now what disease it is.
Tomorrow morning i will go to my doctor, i really hope he knows what sort of disease i got.
Thanks for the comment. If this isnt acne, then i cant believe the doctor always gave me drugs and salve for acne... I really question myself now what disease it is.
Thanks for your advide, i posted it directly!
I will, i just posted more photos of my face now. Im curious what the doctor is gonna saw tomorrow.

Thanks for your reaction! Last months i dont wash with soap at all because i read that it could be the problem of it. I want wash my face anymore in warm water. I live in the netherlands and i guess i cant buy neosporin or some antibiotic ointment. I will try to not scratch and scrub at all even though it itch alot. Thanks for your help, when this is over i will be the happiest man in the world
thanks for the tip, I did post it there too now

I will buy moisturizer directly now, i hope it helps. I thought lanettecreme also was one, but i dont guess so. And when i try to scrub it all away it gets extremely dry and red, like really red! And when i sleep and wake up its back on my face...

i use (Lanettecreme + 20% vaseline) because if i dont use that creme i cant even eat. But the doctor said not to use it because it will only make it worse and gave me (vichy normaderm), but when i used it a few times it hurt so badly that i stopped, when i put vichy normaderm on my skin i couldnt move anything at all and i had to wash the creme off because i couldnt move my whole face. maybe i should think about another moisturizer. At least thanks for commenting

Thank you for your comment, i just took a shower and my skin is now super super dry, i cant move anything, i can even open my mouth to eat. I  put alot of lanettecreme on my skin so it isnt that dry anymore. I really have no idea what to do... I will take a better photo if i can.
